LESSON: LOVE

Grade: Grade 4
Subject: CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
Strand: Christian Values
Topic 4.4: Love

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello learner! Today we will learn about Love. Read carefully, study the examples, do the practice, then try the revision quiz.

Big question: how love to others as taught by Jesus Christ. 1. How did Jesus Christ show love to children?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. recognise that God loves children; Matthew 19:13-15,
2. demonstrate love by showing kindness to others,
3. appreciate God’s love by obeying His teachings. The learner is guided to: love for children, Children (Mathew 19:13-15), children, Christ blessing children, by Jesus Christ. Jesus Christ show love to children? show Godly love to others as a Christian?

SECTION 3: LEARN STEP BY STEP

1. recognise that God loves children; Matthew 19:13-15,
   In this part of the lesson, you learn to recognise that God loves children; Matthew 19:13-15,. Think about how you can do this at school and at home in Kenya.

2. demonstrate love by showing kindness to others,
   In this part of the lesson, you learn to demonstrate love by showing kindness to others,. Think about how you can do this at school and at home in Kenya.

3. appreciate God’s love by obeying His teachings. The learner is guided to: love for children, Children (Mathew 19:13-15), children, Christ blessing children, by Jesus Christ. Jesus Christ show love to children? show Godly love to others as a Christian?
   In this part of the lesson, you learn to appreciate God’s love by obeying His teachings. The learner is guided to: love for children, Children (Mathew 19:13-15), children, Christ blessing children, by Jesus Christ. Jesus Christ show love to children? show Godly love to others as a Christian?. Think about how you can do this at school and at home in Kenya.

SECTION 4: EXAMPLES

Example 1: At home, obey your parent when they ask you to wash your plate. That shows obedience.

Example 2: Tell the truth if you break a cup. Saying what really happened is honesty.

Example 3: Thank God for your family before you sleep. A short prayer can be: “Thank you God for today.”

SECTION 5: TRY THIS

1. Read the examples above again. Underline two new words or ideas about Love.
2. Explain Love to a parent or classmate using your own words and one Kenyan example.
3. Try this activity: role-play Jesus blessing Children (Mathew 19:13-15),
4. Show that you can: recognise that God loves children; Matthew 19:13-15,
5. Complete the Work to do section, then attempt the Revision Quiz. Check Answers only after you finish.

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (PRACTICE & REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about Love. Use examples from your school, home, or market.
2. Answer this question in your exercise book: how love to others as taught by Jesus Christ. 1. How did Jesus Christ show love to children?
3. Make a short oral presentation (about one minute) to your parent or teacher.
4. List three ways you will practise this topic this week.

SECTION 7: CLASS ACTIVITY IDEAS

1. Role-play Jesus blessing Children (Mathew 19:13-15),
2. Draw Jesus praying for children,
3. Watch a video clip on Jesus Christ blessing children,

SECTION 8: REMEMBER

1. recognise that God loves children; Matthew 19:13-15,
2. demonstrate love by showing kindness to others,
3. appreciate God’s love by obeying His teachings. The learner is guided to: love for children, Children (Mathew 19:13-15), children, Christ blessing children, by Jesus Christ. Jesus Christ show love to children? show Godly love to others as a Christian?

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open the Answers tab only after you finish.
